title: Behavioral Grammar: Detecting Adaptive Malware via Tiny Language Model Priors and Second-Order Temporal Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.00745v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern endpoint detection systems face a fundamental tension: signature-based approaches are trivially evaded by polymorphic or adaptive threats, while heavy deep-learning models resist auditability and deployment at scale. This paper presents Behavioral Grammar, a detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language and learns its "grammar" with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT). translated_title: 行为语法：基于微型语言模型先验与二阶时序分析的自适应恶意软件检测
translated_abstract: 现代终端检测系统面临一个根本性矛盾：基于签名的方法极易被多态或自适应威胁规避，而笨重的深度学习模型则难以审计且难以大规模部署。本文提出“行为语法”，这是一种将主机运行时行为视为结构化语言，并使用紧凑的0.88M参数因果Transformer（TinyGPT）学习其“语法”的检测架构。每个系统事件被离散化为一个8-token的表示，涵盖事件类型、进程、参数骨架、路径类别、父进程、用户、目标地址以及事件间时序。该模型以纯自监督方式学习正常行为的条件分布，异常分数由逐槽位的负对数似然（NLL）统计量导出，从而产生数学上有界的误报率。我们利用原型学习对这一先验进行增强，以实现已知攻击的归因，并结合二阶……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“行为语法”检测架构，将主机运行时行为视为结构化语言，用仅0.88M参数的微型因果Transformer（TinyGPT）以纯自监督方式学习正常行为的“语法”，通过逐槽位负对数似然统计实现误报率数学有界的自适应恶意软件检测，并结合原型学习完成已知攻击归因。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Behavioral Grammar, a malware detection architecture that treats host runtime behavior as a structured language, learning the "grammar" of normal behavior with a compact 0.88M-parameter causal Transformer (TinyGPT) in a purely self-supervised manner, deriving anomaly scores from per-slot NLL statistics with mathematically bounded false-positive rates, and augmenting the prior with prototype learning for known-attack attribution.
